_comment: Where people build and host apps that use OpenReceive. Facts only: the site owns logos and marketing copy. generate-site-contract.mjs validates every row and publishes them as platforms[]. A platform is Tested only when trials/passed.json records passing agent trials for its `trial` platform.

platforms.label: Vercel
platforms.summary: Next.js on Vercel with a Neon database. Deploy the starter, or add checkout to your own app.
platforms.database: Neon Postgres, through its pooled URL
platforms.settlement: On page requests, with no worker or cron job

platforms.label: v0
platforms.summary: v0 builds Next.js apps on Vercel. Paste one prompt and v0 adds checkout to your app.
platforms.database: Neon Postgres, installed from the v0 chat or its Integrations
platforms.secrets: Vercel project environment variables; v0's settings link to them
platforms.settlement: On page requests, with no worker or cron job

platforms.label: Replit
platforms.summary: Replit Agent builds Express apps with a built-in Postgres database. Paste one prompt and Agent adds checkout to your app.
platforms.secrets: Replit Secrets, which publishing links to the published app
platforms.settlement: On page requests, with no worker or cron job, so Autoscale fits

platforms.label: Lovable
platforms.summary: Lovable builds TanStack Start apps on Cloudflare Workers, with Supabase.

platforms.label: Supabase
platforms.summary: Store payments in your Supabase Postgres, through its pooled connection or, from Cloudflare Workers, over its HTTPS API.
